recipe.title: Pineapple Cottage Cheese Bowl + Strawberry Cheesecake Shake
recipe.summary: A five-minute cottage cheese and pineapple bowl paired with a creamy strawberry cheesecake protein shake.
recipe.story: This is a no-cook breakfast for mornings when speed matters. The cottage cheese and pineapple stay simple, while the strawberry cheesecake shake adds enough protein to turn the combination into a full 40/400 meal.
ingredients: 1 scoop Clean Simple Eats Strawberry Cheesecake Protein Powder
instructions: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl and top with the drained pineapple.
Blend the Strawberry Cheesecake protein powder, unsweetened almond milk, and ice until smooth.
Serve the cottage cheese bowl and protein shake together.
tips: Drain the pineapple before measuring for the closest match to the listed nutrition.
Use unsweetened almond milk to leave more room under 400 calories.
Nutrition is approximate and may vary by almond milk and protein powder formulation.
